title: Duffy's Tavern
paragraphs: A character comedy set around New York's Duffy's Tavern, where fast-talking manager Archie schemes, argues with the regulars, and tries to impress a steady stream of celebrity guests.
Situation comedy set in the fictional Duffy's Tavern, managed by Archie for the never-heard owner Duffy. Frozen GRH snapshot contains 160 dated recordings through December 28, 1951.

GRH documents the program through CBS era (July 29, 1940 to June 30, 1942), Blue Network era (October 6, 1942 to June 27, 1944), NBC era (September 15, 1944 to December 28, 1951), and Puerto Rico production era (1949 to December 28, 1951).

Among the most extensively documented contributors in the GRH holdings are [[person|ed-gardner|Ed Gardner]] (performer on 126 recordings, director on 35 recordings, and producer on 12 recordings), Charlie Cantor (performer on 98 recordings), [[person|eddie-green|Eddie Green]] (performer on 84 recordings), Matty Malneck and His Orchestra (performer on 50 recordings), Hazel Shermet (performer on 40 recordings), Larry Rhine (writer on 39 recordings), and Florence Halop (performer on 35 recordings).

The program is also connected in the archive to [[org|org.f2f0561f0ce2ddc5|NBC Radio Network]] (broadcast on network), [[org|org.4798d1172deaae2c|Armed Forces Radio Service]] (rebroadcast by), [[org|org.acb290b0843b31ec|Blue Network]] (broadcast on network), and [[org|org.0e05223f9d198710|Nostalgia Broadcasting Corporation]] (syndicated by).

Its indexed subjects and listening characteristics include tavern business and neighborhood social life, celebrity guests and show-business culture, Archie schemes and get-rich plans, music and live entertainment, dating, courtship and romantic pursuit, and money, debt, prices and business problems.
